candidates.name: Nyuksenitsa-Arkhangelsk Gas Pipeline (incl. Severodvinsk, Velsk, Plesetsk, Mirny branches)

evidence.note: Regional press: trunk gas pipeline to Arkhangelsk and Severodvinsk, total 796.9 km including all branches (Velsk, Plesetsk, Mirny); operated by Gazprom transgaz Ukhta. Nyuksenitsa-Arkhangelsk mainline length alone not stated; system total 796.9 km.
Mentions Nyuksenitsa-Arkhangelsk pipeline and planned reconstruction for capacity increase.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for any Arkhangelsk-oblast supply trunk (nearest: P0737-P0738 Bovanenkovo-Ukhta and P5541-5543 Ukhta-Torzhok, which do not cover it). Mainline length unknown (system total 796.9 km incl. branches); diameter unknown. Matches the OSM seed lead. Could be split into mainline plus Severodvinsk/Velsk branches by the consolidator.
